cases.disposition_reason: TablePro with no --page flag opens Connections at 120×40 in truecolor with reduced motion. A click on Development shows host dev-db.internal.acme.io and database acme_dev. Connect finishes on Query 1 in catalog acme_prod › public, with status ✓ Connected to Development. Ctrl+O opens public.organizations. The grid offers Enter Edit and shows no pending marker and no discard dialog. Ctrl+W closes that tab and returns to Query 1, whose status line still says Opened public.organizations. Ctrl+Q exits 0 with no discard dialog.
cases.entry_path: launch tablepro --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40 with no --page flag; click Development; click Connect; Ctrl+O organizations
cases.return_path: Ctrl+W closes the organizations tab and returns to Query 1; Ctrl+Q exits

cases.disposition_reason: On Development, organizations row be6dd084-a1f4-4d47-ae53-915ac89debab shows Tessellate and slug tessellate. The name edit commits DiscardEdit, keeps tessellate, and draws • 1 pending · 1 update. The next row stays Northwind Labs / northwind-labs. U opens Discard unsaved changes? with body 1 pending change will be dropped. The rows are reloaded from the server. Cancel starts focused (▎Cancel, footer Enter Cancel) and Discard is the other button. At 120×40 DiscardEdit stays on row 1 beside the dialog. At 80×24 the same dialog stays open, with • 1 pending · 1 update and rows 1–8 of 500 loaded · 1,240 total, captured before the terminal returns to 120×40. Enter on Cancel closes the dialog, keeps DiscardEdit and the pending marker, and does not show Changes discarded. U again and Enter on the danger Discard button sets status Changes discarded, restores Tessellate on that row, removes DiscardEdit and the pending marker, and leaves Northwind Labs / northwind-labs unchanged. Ctrl+Q exits.
cases.action_sequence: Edit a cell, open discard review, cancel, then confirm.
cases.expected_results: Cancel keeps the edit. Confirm restores the original cell.
cases.forbidden_effects: Discard changes a row that was not pending.
